blocks.text: The Film Academy of the Philippines (FAP) has officially revealed the nominees for the revamped 41st Luna Awards, with Vice Ganda, Pokwang and Ruby Ruiz leading the nominations. This year’s roster honors films released from October 2025 to September 2026 across 20 major, technical, and short-form categories, marking the prestigious award-giving body’s comeback after a two-year hiatus. READ: FAP announces Luna Awards comeback after 2-year absence Leading the pack is the historical biopic Quezon with 13 nominations.
